note: Bendigo's APS 330 disclosure is the APRA regime, not Basel KM1. The half-year report carries the full 'Table 1 Common Disclosure Template', where the capital ratios are rows 61-63 and RWA is row 60, but the three ratios are also printed as loose text at the top of the first template page, above the row-numbered body. The extractor met those first and took them as capital amounts - hence a 'cet1_capital' of around 11 - which is why the CET1 ratio failed its range check. The row-numbered figures are used here instead. One reporting-date column; amounts are AUD millions. No leverage ratio: APRA does not require one in this disclosure and none appears in the document, so the check's 'no leverage ratio row' is correct. The 'header date disagrees with expected 2030-06-30' warning is the extractor misreading the '30 June' in the page header as a year; the reference date is the one stated on the cover. This year's template runs across three pages: CET1 capital 4,082.9 is row 29 (p.5); Tier 2 832.3 row 58, total capital 5,739.3 row 59 and RWA 42,197.9 row 60 (p.6); the ratios are rows 61-63 (p.7). LCR 134.3% is row 25 of Table 20 (p.15), the first of three quarterly columns, being the June 2022 quarter average; NSFR 129.2% is row 34 of Table 21 (p.17), stated in the text as the ratio as at 30 June 2022. Checks: 4,082.9/42,197.9 = 9.68%, 4,907.0/42,197.9 = 11.63% and 5,739.3/42,197.9 = 13.60%, matching rows 61-63. The September 2022 report's comparative column repeats 42,197.9, 9.68, 11.63 and 13.60.
